MQuotientHaar.originalHaar_shell_L1_limit.{u_1, u_2} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)] [BorelSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)]
  [SecondCountableTopology (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] {J : Type u_2} (lambda : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K))
  [lambda.IsHaarMeasure] (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [mu.IsHaarMeasure] (v : ℕ → FinitePlace K)
  (F : J → MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (G : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ)
  (hF : ∀ (j : J), Integrable (F j) mu) (hG : Integrable G mu) (L : Filter J)
  (hlim : Tendsto (fun j => ∫ (z : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), ‖F j z - G z‖ ∂mu) L (𝓝 0)) :
  Tendsto
    (fun j =>
      ∑' (e : Option ℕ),
        ‖∫ (y : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K),
              ↑(NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K y) * ↑(NDivisorialShells.upstairsMask K v e y) *
                F j ↑y ∂lambda -
            ∫ (y : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K),
              ↑(NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K y) * ↑(NDivisorialShells.upstairsMask K v e y) *
                G ↑y ∂lambda‖)
    L (𝓝 0)
